description.purpose: One-shot shell execution (bash is one-shot only by ruling -- no persistent sessions; chain cwd via 'cd /x && cmd').
description.use_when: The `bash` occupant of a tools hive, reached on hop.tool_name == 'bash'. Same cell as the coder pipeline's runner, with one difference that is the point: it ships sandboxed.
description.not_in_scope: No session state. Sandboxing is NOT out of scope here and this is the one occupant that declares it: `trust: restricted`, `network: deny`, `filesystem.runtime: true` -- the shell may reach the runtime it needs to start and nothing else. That block is the measurement GH #286 took on the shipped instance, written down rather than inferred, and it is one of the four inputs to the sandbox union this template declares.
description.emits_meaning: messages[]: one tool_result turn (stdout + sentinel-marked stderr). hop.exit_code always set -- non-zero is a normal result.
